verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing supports background automation via transaction rules that automatically approve/decline authorizations without manual intervention, and relayed-authorization webhooks that must be answered programmatically within 2000ms, both of which run autonomously once configured. However, there's no evidence of AI-native automation tooling, scheduling, or agent-style orchestration beyond simple rule-based logic. Missing for 10: AI-specific automation/agent framework, richer workflow/orchestration docs, and independent corroboration of rules running reliably in production.
